evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app with shadcn/ui (base-nova preset, lucide icons). Create a settings form component with fields for: full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push notifications as toggle options). Add validation states for required fields.
evals.expected_output: A React component using FieldGroup, Field, ToggleGroup, data-invalid/aria-invalid validation, gap-* spacing, and semantic colors.
expectations: Uses FieldGroup and Field components for form layout instead of raw div with space-y
Uses Switch for independent on/off notification toggles (not looping Button with manual active state)
Uses data-invalid on Field and aria-invalid on the input control for validation states
Uses gap-* (e.g. gap-4, gap-6) instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses semantic color tokens (e.g. bg-background, text-muted-foreground, text-destructive) instead of raw colors like bg-red-500
No manual dark: color overrides

evals.prompt: Create a dialog component for editing a user profile. It should have the user's avatar at the top, input fields for name and bio, and Save/Cancel buttons with appropriate icons. Using shadcn/ui with radix-nova preset and tabler icons.
evals.expected_output: A React component with DialogTitle, Avatar+AvatarFallback, data-icon on icon buttons, no icon sizing classes, tabler icon imports.
expectations: Includes DialogTitle for accessibility (visible or with sr-only class)
Avatar component includes AvatarFallback
Icons on buttons use the data-icon attribute (data-icon="inline-start" or data-icon="inline-end")
No sizing classes on icons inside components (no size-4, w-4, h-4, etc.)
Uses tabler icons (@tabler/icons-react) instead of lucide-react
Uses asChild for custom triggers (radix preset)

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard component that shows 4 stat cards in a grid. Each card has a title, large number, percentage change badge, and a loading skeleton state. Using shadcn/ui with base-nova preset and lucide icons.
evals.expected_output: A React component with full Card composition, Skeleton for loading, Badge for changes, semantic colors, gap-* spacing.
expectations: Uses full Card composition with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent (not dumping everything into CardContent)
Uses Skeleton component for loading placeholders instead of custom animate-pulse divs
Uses Badge component for percentage change instead of custom styled spans
Uses semantic color tokens instead of raw color values like bg-green-500 or text-red-600
Uses gap-* instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses size-* when width and height are equal instead of separate w-* h-*

evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app with shadcn/ui (base-nova preset, lucide icons). Build a chat conversation view: a scrollable thread of messages from two different people, each with an avatar, sender name, timestamp, and message bubble. A couple of messages include an image attachment and a PDF file attachment, and there's a 'Today' divider separating the days.
evals.expected_output: A React component composing MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, and Marker from the registry instead of hand-rolled bubble/divider/attachment markup.
expectations: Uses MessageScroller (MessageScrollerProvider, MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent, MessageScrollerItem) for the scrollable thread instead of a raw overflow-y-auto div or ScrollArea
Wraps each row in MessageScrollerItem inside MessageScrollerContent
Uses Message with MessageAvatar/MessageContent/MessageHeader for row layout instead of custom flex divs
Uses Bubble + BubbleContent for the message surface instead of a styled div with bg-muted/bg-primary
Uses Attachment (AttachmentMedia, AttachmentContent, AttachmentTitle, AttachmentDescription) for the file and image attachments instead of Item or a custom card
Uses Marker (variant="separator") for the 'Today' divider instead of Separator plus a centered label
Uses semantic color tokens and gap-* spacing; no raw colors like bg-emerald-500 and no space-y-*
Includes "use client" when the component uses state or event handlers (isRSC)

evals.prompt: Using shadcn/ui (base-nova preset, lucide icons), build a streaming AI chat UI. The assistant's reply streams in while it generates, the view auto-scrolls to follow the latest content but stops following if the user scrolls up to read earlier messages, a 'jump to latest' button appears when the user has scrolled away from the bottom, and a subtle 'thinking…' shimmer shows while the model is generating.
evals.expected_output: A React component that delegates scroll/anchor behavior to MessageScroller and uses MessageScrollerButton for jump-to-latest and the shimmer utility for the thinking indicator — no hand-rolled scroll logic or custom shimmer keyframes.
expectations: Uses MessageScroller with MessageScrollerProvider (autoScroll) and scrollAnchor on message items for the stick-to-bottom/follow behavior instead of a custom useStickToBottom hook or ResizeObserver/scrollTop wiring
Uses MessageScrollerButton for the jump-to-latest control instead of a hand-built conditional button driven by manual scroll-position state
Uses the shimmer utility class for the 'thinking…' indicator instead of a custom @keyframes or bg-clip-text gradient animation
Wraps each message row in MessageScrollerItem inside MessageScrollerContent
Uses Message + Bubble + BubbleContent for the conversation rows instead of hand-rolled bubble divs
Uses semantic color tokens and gap-* spacing; includes "use client" (isRSC)

evals.prompt: Build me a design system using preset b0. Use the DESIGN.md in this folder (a productivity-app spec: white canvas, #0075DE primary, 8px buttons, 12px cards, multi-layer soft shadows, 2px blue focus outline with 2px offset).
evals.expected_output: A new Vite app created with init --preset b0 --template vite, every component installed, a design system page that renders all of them, and the DESIGN.md tokens mapped onto the shadcn theme.
expectations: Creates the app with init --preset b0 --template vite --name <app> and passes the preset code through without decoding it
Installs every component with add --all and reports the component count from disk
Reads the DESIGN.md Do's and Don'ts and Known Gaps before editing the theme
Maps DESIGN.md colors onto shadcn variables in the existing tailwindCssFile and registers extra tokens in @theme inline instead of creating a new CSS file
Pins the radius scale in @theme inline and overrides the shadow scale with the documented multi-layer shadows
Implements the 2px outline focus with an offset instead of keeping the default ring
Changes field control heights together with the button height
Renders every installed component on the design system page and runs the coverage check
Verifies in a browser: typecheck, no console errors, page loads at the top, no horizontal overflow
Shows color roles as surface/foreground pairs with measured contrast ratios
Shows a variant × state matrix for Button with hover, focus, active and disabled pinned via data-preview
Renders do/don't pairs for rules from the DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: Create a Next.js design system app called editorial from preset b0 and apply this DESIGN.md: cream canvas #faf9f5, coral primary #cc785c that darkens only on press, licensed serif display (substitute Cormorant Garamond), Inter body, dark #181715 product surfaces, 40px buttons and inputs.
evals.expected_output: A Next.js app with all components, serif display type utilities, coral primary with an active-only darker state, dark bands scoped with the dark class, and a showcase page covering every component.
expectations: Uses --template next with --preset b0 and --name editorial
Installs the documented font substitutes from Fontsource instead of linking licensed fonts
Defines type-* utilities for the display scale with serif family, weight 400-500 and negative tracking, instead of --text-* theme keys
Uses active: rather than hover: for the primary darker state, per the DESIGN.md
Raises button and input heights to 40px across button, input, input-group, select and related controls
Uses className="dark" on sections or cards to render dark product surfaces with the same components
Avoids the cmdk mount scroll jump on the inline Command example
Reports deliberate deviations from the DESIGN.md (font substitutes, kept hover, derived values)

evals.prompt: Create a new design system using shadcn and the following DESIGN.md. <DESIGN.md: editorial cream canvas, coral primary, 40px controls, 12px cards, 16px hero container, pill badges, shadows rare, generous 32px card padding>
evals.expected_output: A new app scaffolded without a preset code by picking a style that matches the DESIGN.md geometry, then themed, with a full design system page.
expectations: Does not ask for or invent a preset code; passes --base base --preset <style> so init doesn't stop at an interactive prompt
Picks a style matching the DESIGN.md geometry (e.g. maia for generous spacing and 12px+ cards, or sera for editorial serif type) and states the reason in one line
Passes --no-monorepo and --template vite (or next when asked)
Installs all components and builds the design system page per design-system-page.md
Reports contrast pairs below 4.5:1, including the DESIGN.md's own primary/on-primary pair if it fails

evals.prompt: Add the toggle-group and carousel components to this shadcn-dream project (Next.js, radix base, lib/cva.ts already set up).
evals.expected_output: Both components installed with the CLI, then rewritten into dream shape and verified with dream-audit.mjs, typecheck and lint.
expectations: Treats the project as the adopt case (lib/cva.ts present) and does not re-run the migration
Installs with `npx shadcn@latest add` (or the project's runner), not by fetching raw files
Rewrites every file the CLI reported created or updated, not only the main component file
Imports cn and cva from the project's lib/cva module and VariantProps as a type from the cva package
Every cva call uses the object form with a base key; variant calls receive className instead of being wrapped in cn()
Each component and sub-component is exported at its declaration with an exported <Name>Props interface; no trailing export block
No `import * as React`; runtime React APIs (createContext, useState, useCallback) are named imports
Runs `npx shadcn@latest migrate radix` if any added file imports @radix-ui/react-*
Removes class-variance-authority, clsx or tailwind-merge from package.json and deletes a recreated lib/utils.ts if the CLI added them
Runs scripts/dream-audit.mjs on the written set and reports it exits 0, plus typecheck and lint

evals.prompt: This Next.js project was set up with the default shadcn CLI (lib/utils.ts with clsx + tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, 20 components, TypeScript 5.8). Migrate it to shadcn-dream.
evals.expected_output: Migration per migrate.md: inventory, dependencies, lib/cva.ts, every component and app-code cn import rewritten, CSS base layer merged, leftovers removed, verified.
expectations: Treats the project as the migrate case and follows migrate.md
Builds an inventory of every file importing class-variance-authority, lib/utils, clsx or tailwind-merge before editing
Pins cva to exactly 1.0.0-beta.12 in dependencies, adds cn, and raises TypeScript to 6 in the same install
Creates lib/cva.ts with defineConfig from "cva/config" and cx set to cn from the cn package
Rewrites every component under the ui path with all dream rules, not a sample
Rewrites cn imports in app code outside the ui path to lib/cva without forcing Props interfaces on app components
Merges the dream html/body rules into the existing @layer base block instead of replacing shadcn's rules
Deletes lib/utils.ts and removes class-variance-authority, clsx and tailwind-merge only after nothing imports them
Leaves classes, data-slot attributes and behavior unchanged
Verifies with dream-audit.mjs (full rules on components, --rules 1,2,3,8 elsewhere), typecheck and lint
